title: E-RLT-0047: no single emergent metric absorbs the committed knit's anisotropy: its dense-background kinetic tensor...
purpose: Experiment E-RLT-0047 in the relativity arena: no single emergent metric absorbs the committed knit's anisotropy: its dense-background kinetic tensor is nearly isotropic while its vacuum lone-tone tensor is not, the two stay further apart than the pre-registered 0.1 at sides 9, 13 and 17, and pure streaming, where both are proportional, shows the test can pass; a third tensor, the sound tensor fitted from peak frequencies, is a quadratic form for the committed knit (residual 0.064) and disagrees with both (distances 0.95 and 1.12), so three rank-2 responses point three ways.
